mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin SET login_fail_cnt = login_fail_cnt + 1, status_cd = CASE WHEN login_fail_cnt + 1 >= #{lockThreshold} THEN 'LOCKED' ELSE status_cd END WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
UPDATE tb_admin SET login_fail_cnt = 0, last_login_dt = now() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_admin_login_hist (admin_id, login_id, result_cd, auth_type_cd, ip_addr, user_agent) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{loginId}, #{resultCd}, #{authTypeCd}, #{ipAddr}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT r.role_cd, r.role_nm, r.use_yn FROM tb_admin_role ar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY r.role_id

SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_cd, p.action_cd FROM tb_admin_role ar JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_id = ar.role_id AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_id = rp.perm_id JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = p.menu_id AND m.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_menu p1 ON p1.menu_id = m.parent_menu_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu p2 ON p2.menu_id = p1.parent_menu_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND coalesce(p1.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y' AND coalesce(p2.use_yn, 'Y') = 'Y'
SELECT reg_dt, ip_addr FROM tb_admin_login_hist WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND result_cd = 'SUCCESS' ORDER BY reg_dt DESC, hist_id DESC OFFSET 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT password FROM tb_admin WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_admin SET admin_nm = #{adminNm}, email = #{email}, mobile_no = #{mobileNo}, dept_nm = #{deptNm}, mod_id = #{adminId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND date_trunc('second', mod_dt) = date_trunc('second', #{modDt}::timestamp)
UPDATE tb_admin SET password = #{password}, pwd_temp_yn = 'N', pwd_changed_dt = now(), mod_id = #{adminId}, mod_dt = now() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_admin WHERE login_id = #{loginId})
mapper.insert: WITH new_admin AS ( INSERT INTO tb_admin (login_id, password, admin_nm, email, status_cd, pwd_temp_yn) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{adminNm}, #{email}, 'ACTIVE', 'Y') RETURNING admin_id ) INSERT INTO tb_admin_role (admin_id, role_id) SELECT new_admin.admin_id, r.role_id FROM new_admin JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_cd = #{roleCd}
